title: System constitution and machine contract
goal: Freeze CEW authority model, core domains, promotion boundary and milestone governance.
reference_case: N12 existing canonical gates and ERW contracts remain semantically valid

title: Immutable source identity and storage
goal: Create reproducible identity and storage semantics for every primary source and derived asset.
required_deliverables: Source/SourceVersion schema;content-addressed locator contract;hash/version policy;source registry adapter;derived-asset authority rules
reference_case: TAV-05A and TAV-06A resolve to immutable source identities without ad-hoc crop authority

title: Page region observation provenance model
goal: Represent exact source regions and literal observations independently from interpretation.
required_deliverables: Page model;PageTransform registry;EvidenceRegion schema;coordinate-system contract;Observation schema;provenance chain;reproducibility validator
reference_case: G01-R06 G07-R07 G05-R04 and T6A-G03 reconstruct reproducibly from immutable SourceVersion to exact region and finalized Observation

title: Deep source navigation vertical slice
goal: Prove mature source navigation without changing structural authority.
required_deliverables: deep-zoom viewer;tile pyramid;native coordinates;permalink/view state;original/enhanced separation;source readiness gate
reference_case: ERW-N12-001..004 open at reproducible evidence context from TAV-05A/TAV-06A without changing F2 geometry

title: Bounded AI technical observation pipeline
goal: Allow specialist AI workers to create auditable observations and candidates without canonical writes.
required_deliverables: EvidencePack contract;worker output envelope;method+ceiling metadata;initial layout/text/reinforcement worker adapters;AI no-direct-promotion validator
reference_case: Four answer-blind N12 EvidencePacks validate; unreadable fields remain unsupported; authority violations are rejected; T6A-G03 remains UNBOUND

title: Structural knowledge and binding graph
goal: Represent structural entities properties claims bindings temporal states and per-property epistemic authority.
required_deliverables: StructuralEntity/Property/Assertion/Binding schemas;temporal state model;drawing-rule objects;CSV projection adapters;graph validators
reference_case: Existing N12 M0-G/M1A/M1L facts can be projected into the graph without authority loss or geometry reopen

title: Evidence Resolution Workspace end-to-end
goal: Give a technician source+model context, issue sequence, candidate comparison and explicit dispositions.
required_deliverables: 2D/3D synchronized workspace;task queue;known/unknown/conflict panels;candidate toggles;review views;decision receipts
reference_case: M1E-B06-R11 can be reviewed and dispositioned UNBOUND reproducibly without opening CSV/GitHub

title: Validation promotion and residual orchestration
goal: Turn observations and decisions into deterministic canonical promotions or retained residuals.
required_deliverables: promotion engine;epistemic ceiling enforcement;dependency graph;residual prioritization;reopen protocol integration;canonical snapshot receipts
reference_case: A valid N12 decision updates only its allowed canonical projection and reruns relevant gate; invalid promotion is rejected

title: Calculation handoff and fascicolo
goal: Generate explicit assessment-model inputs, assumptions, coverage, exports and audit-ready reporting.
required_deliverables: AnalysisAssumption schema;CalculationHandoff package;coverage report;export adapters;fascicolo provenance report
reference_case: N12 handoff states known inputs assumptions blockers and provenance without using FEM results as documentary evidence

title: Reference-project usable MVP
goal: Prove CEW as one coherent evidence-to-assessment workflow on N12.
required_deliverables: control room;global search;entity evidence drill-down;end-to-end task continuation;canonical snapshots;operator documentation
reference_case: A technician unfamiliar with repository internals can ingest/navigate/review/resolve/hand off selected N12 scope without editing canonical CSV files

title: Second-project portability
goal: Demonstrate that CEW is a reusable system rather than N12-specific automation.
required_deliverables: project bootstrap;source taxonomy configuration;drawing grammar isolation;portable validators;second-project acceptance pack
reference_case: A second existing-building project runs the foundation workflow without N12 hard-coded identifiers
